verdict.rationale: BILL documents an official MCP server that lets AI editors like Cursor and Windsurf, and tools like Claude Desktop, connect to it. Its scope is limited to the BILL API documentation, not live Spend & Expense data or actions such as cards, budgets, transactions or reimbursements. The llms.txt probe further supports agent-oriented docs access but not product operation. Missing for 10: an MCP server exposing Spend & Expense account operations and data, auth/setup details for agent access to org data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
